housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 2,634 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre. DC guidance says a security deposit may not exceed one month's rent. DCHousingSearch.org is the District's free affordable-housing rental listing and search engine. Sources: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Washington https://dds.dc.gov/page/h-whate-are-10-steps-tenancy https://www.dchousingsearch.org/index.html

banking.summary: Bank of America states that eligible non-US-citizen international professionals with a physical US address open in person and provide foreign and US addresses, two IDs, and a foreign tax identification number; a US TIN/ITIN is required only if already issued. Source: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account
required_docs: Proof of foreign home or permanent residence address
Proof of physical US address, such as a photo government ID, current utility bill, or rental agreement
One primary ID, such as a foreign passport with or without a visa
One secondary ID, such as a foreign or US driver's license or an eligible debit or credit card
Foreign tax identification number; US TIN/ITIN only if one has been issued

schools.summary: Washington International School in Washington, DC offers French or Spanish language immersion/dual-language study and enrolls all grades 11-12 students in the IB Diploma Programme. My School DC's School Finder searches District schools by address, grade, and program type. Sources: https://www.wis.edu/ https://www.myschooldc.org/node/29536
curricula: French or Spanish immersion and dual-language study

legal_admin.summary: No general DC municipal residence-registration step was identified. Federally, most noncitizens must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days of moving using the online account tool or paper Form AR-11; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt. Source: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange
legal_admin.registration_step: Most noncitizens must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days through a USCIS online account or by filing Form AR-11; exceptions apply to A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a US taxpayer identification number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number by submitting Form W-7, a federal income tax return unless an exception applies, and supporting identity/foreign-status documents, by mail or through an authorized in-person option. Source: https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/how-to-apply-for-an-itin

transport.summary: WMATA operates Metro Rail and Metro Bus; Monthly Unlimited Passes cost USD 72-216 depending on fare level. A non-US citizen residing in DC more than 30 days and not on a visitor visa must obtain a DC license; a valid foreign-license holder must pass the knowledge test but not the road-skills test and may keep the foreign license. DC has no universal public-healthcare registration; eligible District residents may apply for MAGI Medicaid through District Direct, while non-MAGI applicants use the Integrated Application for Medical Assistance. Sources: https://www.wmata.com/pay/pay-passes.html https://dmv.dc.gov/service/driver-license-for-non-us-citizens https://dhcf.dc.gov/service/how-qualify-dc-medicaid https://districtdirect.dc.gov/ua/
transport.network_name: Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) Metro Rail and Metro Bus
transport.driving_licence_exchange: If residing in DC for more than 30 days and not on a visitor visa, obtain a DC license. With a valid non-US license, pass the DC knowledge test; no road-skills test is required, proof of ability to drive is required, and the foreign license may be retained.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible DC residents may apply for MAGI Medicaid through District Direct; non-MAGI applicants submit the Integrated Application for Medical Assistance.
